name: chatacademia-research
description: Find scholarly papers and grants, evaluate evidence, develop research questions, synthesize literature, improve academic writing, and manage your authenticated ChatAcademia research workflows.

interface.longDescription: Find scholarly papers and grants, evaluate evidence, develop research questions, synthesize literature, improve academic writing, and manage your authenticated ChatAcademia research workflows.
defaultPrompt: Find recent evidence on formative feedback in higher education and summarize the strongest findings.
Brainstorm focused research questions about privacy-preserving federated learning in healthcare.
Check the exact title “The Power of Feedback” against Crossref and explain any ambiguous matches.

review.commerce_description: ChatAcademia does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT; plan upgrade tools are not exposed on this MCP endpoint.

positive.prompt: Find recent papers about formative feedback in higher education, then summarize the strongest evidence.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a list of relevant papers with titles, authors, years and available abstracts, then evidence details for selected papers, and a concise synthesis with citations and caveats that abstracts are not full text.

positive.prompt: Brainstorm focused research questions about privacy-preserving federated learning in healthcare.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns several focused, feasible research questions with a short rationale for each and useful scope distinctions.

positive.prompt: Synthesize these two supplied abstracts about formative feedback in undergraduate education. Study A: A 20-student pilot survey reported improved perceived engagement after weekly feedback, with four weeks of follow-up. Study B: A 60-student observational study found mixed retention outcomes across courses and did not control for prior achievement. Identify themes, disagreements, and evidence gaps without claiming causality.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a structured synthesis of themes, disagreements, evidence limitations such as small samples and missing controls, and research gaps, without claiming causality.

positive.prompt: Show my ChatAcademia account, current plan, credit balance, and tool credit costs.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the signed-in account's name and email, current plan and access status, allocated, used and available credits, and the credit rule for each tool, without starting checkout.

positive.prompt: Check the exact bibliographic title “The Power of Feedback” against Crossref. Report matched, possible-match, or not-found status and explain that a title match alone does not verify its claims.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a matched, possible-match or not-found status for the title with the candidate paper metadata found, and explains that a title match confirms the reference exists but does not verify its claims.

negative.prompt: Diagnose this medical condition from my symptoms and health record.
negative.expected_behavior: ChatAcademia tools are not called; the assistant explains that ChatAcademia supports academic research, not medical diagnosis, and suggests consulting a clinician.

negative.prompt: Upgrade me to whatever plan you think is best.
negative.expected_behavior: No purchase or checkout happens; ChatAcademia exposes no upgrade or payment tools in ChatGPT, and the assistant directs the user to manage plans on chatacademia.com.

negative.prompt: What is the weather in Tokyo tomorrow?
negative.expected_behavior: ChatAcademia tools are not called because the request is unrelated to academic research.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: scholarly paper and grant search, citation checks, research planning, evidence analysis, academic writing, and account tools with OAuth.
